register.labelZh: STRETCH 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: stretch away 和 stretch out 可以描寫群山、田野、道路和海灘向遠方延伸。；stretch out 可以表示伸直身體躺下休息。；stretch something out 可以描述伸出手、手臂、腿或身體其他部分。；stretch out 可以表示土地向遠方延伸,也可以表示一個人伸直身體躺下。完整情境會顯示所需意思。
register.summaryEn: Stretch away and stretch out can describe mountains, fields, roads and beaches continuing far into the distance. Stretch out can describe lying down with your body fully extended. Stretch something out can describe extending a hand, arm, leg or other part of the body. Stretch out may describe land extending into the distance or a person lying down. The full situation shows the intended meaning.

fixedVariable.variableZh: 使用 stretch yourself out 時,請按人物改變 yourself:I stretched myself out.She stretched herself out.They stretched themselves out.；towards the sea、into the distance 和 for miles 等字詞只補充方向或距離,並非 stretch away 或stretch out 的固定部分。；在 stretch ... out 中使用 it 時,把 it 放在 stretch 和 out 中間:stretch it out
fixedVariable.variableEn: With stretch yourself out, change yourself to match the person: I stretched myself out. She stretched herself out. They stretched themselves out. Words such as towards the sea, into the distance and for miles add information about direction or distance. They are not fixed parts of stretch away or stretch out. When using it in a stretch... out expression, place it between stretch and out: stretch it out
